fixes.explanation: That's him, baker! The text says the Merarites' carts and oxen were "…all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest." (Numbers 7:8). That's four carts and eight oxen to look after. Somebody had to be the one watching that herd, and I'd have lasted about five minutes before I lost count.

Nice try, but carts of their own never come up in the text. The reason it gives is that the Kohathites "…were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible." (Numbers 7:9). Their job was carried by hand, so wheels weren't what the work called for. I once tried to carry a full tray of cookies on my head. Don't ask how that went.
